info.name: Clearwake PayPal sandbox calls
info.description:
Every PayPal call that clearwake/paypal.py makes, against https://api-m.sandbox.paypal.com only. Each request has tests on PayPal's response: status code, id shape, status values, USD amounts with two decimals.

Setup: import sandbox.environment.template.json, fill client_id and client_secret from your own PayPal sandbox app (Postman keeps the secret on your machine; never commit a filled environment), then run the folders in order. The token request is run first by the collection pre-request script.

Run order needs real sandbox state: an order the sandbox buyer approved before Capture order, and a dispute the sandbox buyer opened in the Resolution Center before folder 3. Those cannot be created by API (POST /v1/customer/disputes returns 400 No permissions to set target_client_id for this app).

exec: // Folder 4 (local console) never touches PayPal and may only go to this machine.
const target = pm.variables.replaceIn(pm.request.url.toString());
if (pm.request.url.getPath().indexOf('/console') === 0 || pm.request.url.getPath() === '/healthz') {

if (!/^http:\/\/(127\.0\.0\.1|localhost)(:[0-9]+)?\//.test(target)) { throw new Error('console_url must be http://127.0.0.1:8810 (the local console). The attack suite is never run against a hosted site.'); }
return;
// Sandbox only. Refuse any other host, then make sure a token exists.
const base = pm.environment.get('base_url') || '';
if (base !== 'https://api-m.sandbox.paypal.com') { throw new Error('base_url must be https://api-m.sandbox.paypal.com. Clearwake never calls production.'); }
if (pm.request.url.getPath().indexOf('/v1/oauth2/token') !== -1) { return; }
if (pm.environment.get('access_token')) { return; }
const id = pm.environment.get('client_id'), secret = pm.environment.get('client_secret');
if (!id || !secret) { throw new Error('Fill client_id and client_secret in the environment (your own sandbox app).'); }
const basic = CryptoJS.enc.Base64.stringify(CryptoJS.enc.Utf8.parse(id + ':' + secret));
pm.sendRequest({url: base + '/v1/oauth2/token', method: 'POST', header: {Authorization: 'Basic ' + basic, 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},
body: {mode: 'urlencoded', urlencoded: [{key: 'grant_type', value: 'client_credentials'}]}}, (err, res) => {
if (err || res.code !== 200) { throw new Error('Token request failed'); }
pm.environment.set('access_token', res.json().access_token);
const body = () => { try { return pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { return {}; } };
pm.test('response time under 15 s (Clearwake timeout)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(15000));
pm.test('no PayPal debug id leaks a secret: body has no client secret', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include(pm.environment.get('client_secret') || '\u0000'));
pm.test('status is 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('token_type is Bearer', () => pm.expect(String(body().token_type).toLowerCase()).to.eql('bearer'));
pm.test('access_token is a non-empty string without line breaks', () => { const t = body().access_token; pm.expect(t).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(t).to.not.match(/[\r\n]/); });
pm.test('expires_in is an integer of at least 60', () => { const n = body().expires_in; pm.expect(Number.isInteger(n)).to.be.true; pm.expect(n).to.be.at.least(60); });
pm.environment.set('access_token', body().access_token);

request.description: clearwake/paypal.py SandboxGateway._access_token. Clearwake accepts a token only if it is a non-empty string, token_type Bearer and expires_in at least 60.

item.name: Read the negotiation steps (after a short wait)

exec: // Give the background negotiation time to write its receipts (local run, a few seconds at most).
setTimeout(function () {}, 6000);
const body = () => { try { return pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { return {}; } };
pm.test('response time under 5 s on the local console', () => pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(5000));
pm.test('status is 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('shape: running, error, case, steps', () => { pm.expect(body().running).to.be.a('boolean'); pm.expect(body()).to.have.property('error'); pm.expect(body()).to.have.property('case'); pm.expect(body().steps).to.be.an('array'); });

pm.test('every step has a number, a step id, an action id, ok and a time', () => body().steps.forEach(s => { pm.expect(s.n).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(s.step).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(s.action).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(s.ok).to.be.a('boolean'); pm.expect(s.at).to.match(/^[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}$/); }));

pm.test('once finished: no error, decision then offer then settlement, and the last step succeeded', () => { if (!body().running) { pm.expect(body().error).to.be.null; const a = body().steps.map(s => s.action); pm.expect(a[0]).to.eql('clearwake.dispute.decision'); pm.expect(a).to.include('clearwake.dispute.offer_sent'); pm.expect(a).to.include('clearwake.dispute.settlement'); pm.expect(body().steps[body().steps.length - 1].ok).to.be.true; } });
pm.test('step numbers go up by one', () => body().steps.forEach((s, i, a) => { if (i) pm.expect(s.n).to.eql(a[i - 1].n + 1); }));

pm.test('response has the security headers', () => { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('X-Content-Type-Options')).to.eql('nosniff'); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('X-Frame-Options')).to.eql('DENY'); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Cache-Control')).to.eql('no-store'); });

pm.test('content security policy forbids framing and outside scripts', () => { const p = pm.response.headers.get('Content-Security-Policy') || ''; pm.expect(p).to.include("default-src 'none'"); pm.expect(p).to.include("frame-ancestors 'none'"); });
